module_summary: Nine-state Moore controller: after synchronous active-low reset it pulses one output for a cycle, detects a 1-0-1 pattern on one input, then asserts a second output while checking another input within two cycles, locking on or off permanently.

anchors.name: n16_1f2
anchors.why: Nine-state register: start pulse, pattern detection, two-cycle check, and terminal lock states.

anchors.name: n9_501
anchors.why: Output asserted during the check window and in the locked-on state.

anchors.name: n3_f34
anchors.why: One-cycle output pulse in the state right after reset.

groups.name: controller
groups.description: State register, next-state logic and Moore output decode.
